purpose: Machine-readable index of current lifecycle and authority. Live code and closed contracts remain behavioral authority; this registry routes agents to them and must not be used as runtime configuration.

components.name: Legacy workbook production pipeline
components.safe_extension_boundary: Compatibility fixes and current production behavior only; new canonical semantics should start in source-native contracts where supported.
components.notes: The saved workbook is the delivered artifact for this path, not canonical source authority for economic facts. Accepted publication is now fail-closed and candidate-isolated through component:workbook-finalization-publication@1, including validated serialized readback before atomic promotion; this does not wire the source-native Promise Progress workbook bridge.

components.name: Legacy writer-owned economic and presentation logic
components.safe_extension_boundary: Preserve accepted production output; do not add a second canonical truth engine.
components.notes: Some economics still live here. That is documented compatibility debt, not the preferred extension model. Material finalization failures now surface as typed WorkbookFinalizationError results and block the accepted publication lifecycle; optional enrichment remains non-material only when explicitly classified.

components.name: Source acquisition and cache materialization
components.canonical_owner: pbi_xbrl.source_acquisition transaction primitives; pbi_xbrl.sec_ingest and pbi_xbrl.source_material_refresh source-specific policy
components.safe_extension_boundary: Source-specific modules discover and validate policy; source_acquisition.py alone owns staged validation, content hashing, fsync and atomic final-path publication.
components.notes: The accepted source transaction is acquire -> same-filesystem stage -> validate -> content hash -> fsync where applicable -> atomic replace -> published receipt. Nonempty size alone is not cache validity.

components.name: Semantic cache identity and version catalog
consumers: pipeline bundle and stage key builders
components.safe_extension_boundary: Add shared semantic versions and deterministic identity primitives here; keep each cache's business payload builder beside its producer.
components.notes: Owns contract:semantic-cache-identity@1, v1_canonical_json_sha256 and SEMANTIC_CACHE_VERSIONS. Current dimensions include unit_norm=v1_table_local_source_unit, adjustment_domain=v1_table_role_measure_domain, document_period=v2_registered_document_identity, debt_period=v1_visual_xbrl_context, adjusted_history=v1_metric_definition_scope, inline_xbrl_text=v1_continued_at_chain and debt_rate=v1_role_period_authority.

components.name: Inline-XBRL semantic fact-text reconstruction
components.safe_extension_boundary: Consume canonical fact text before semantic date, debt or source parsing; extend continuation behavior only through contract mutation tests.
components.notes: Owns contract:inline-xbrl-fact-text@1. Missing, duplicate, cyclic or excessive continuedAt chains fail closed and DOM order outside the explicit chain is irrelevant.

components.name: Debt-rate semantic ownership
components.safe_extension_boundary: Add a source-supported DebtRateRole plus explicit concept/table authority and conflict mutations.
prohibited_ownership: workbook-visible rate cell as source authority
components.notes: Owns contract:debt-rate-semantic-ownership@1. Instrument, reporting period, rate role and basis/scope precede numeric selection; source occurrence is lineage.

components.name: Debt facility-row duplicate ownership
components.safe_extension_boundary: Extend facility identity only with economically meaningful period, instrument, concept, basis or scope dimensions.
components.notes: Identical facts corroborate, explicit authority resolves compatible evidence, and conflicting same-authority facts fail closed with lineage. This is facility/debt fact identity, not debt-rate fact identity.

components.name: Fail-closed workbook finalization and publication
components.canonical_owner: pbi_xbrl.excel_writer_core finalization; pbi_xbrl.excel_writer candidate publication; stock_models final promotion
components.safe_extension_boundary: Classify each finalization stage as material or explicitly optional; validate in memory and after temporary serialization before atomic promotion.
components.notes: Accepted sequence is materialization -> classified finalization -> in-memory validation -> temporary serialization -> serialized readback -> atomic promotion. Material failures block publication.

components.name: Quarter Notes intentionally-empty state
components.safe_extension_boundary: Only a runtime-owned explicit product state may authorize valid empty readback; add producers with false-green mutations.
components.notes: Valid intentionally-empty is distinct from parser failure, missing source/input and unexpected empty readback.

components.name: Derivative runtime-sheet materialization failure semantics
components.safe_extension_boundary: Declare dependency-unavailable optional states in the sector/module contract; treat renderer failure after a valid build as material.
components.notes: Runtime-sheet ownership remains declarative. Optional dependency absence and materialization failure are separate states.
